name: Carmen
title: Monastir Knights
description: The Deputy Master of the Knights of the Duchy of Monastir. The shield of the order, who never loses her calm smile even in the most difficult situations.
introduction:
Deputy Master of the Monastir Knights.

Due to her conduct on the battlefield and out, Carmen has earned the respect and adoration of all her fellow knights.
No matter the situation, she calmly steps forward and looks after her subordinates with a warm smile. No matter how strong the enemy, her massive shield stands tall on the frontlines, protecting those around and behind her.
Because no one, knight or otherwise, has ever seen her struggle or falter, they firmly believe she will never waver.

After receiving her invitation, Carmen joins the Journey in the hopes that the Star Savior's power will allow her to protect even more people.
